target.description: Target is the full resource name of the resource to which the policy will be bound. Immutable once set.
target.rationale: Defines the exact principal scope for IAM binding enforcement, preventing unauthorized identity expansion.

principal_set.description: Full Resource Name of the principal set used for principal access boundary policy bindings.
principal_set.rationale: Ensures only approved identity domains (org/workforce/workspace) are used.

policy.description: Required. Immutable. The resource name of the policy to be bound.
policy.rationale: Ensures binding only approved Principal Access Boundary policies within the organization.

organization.description: Parent organization of the Policy Binding.
organization.rationale: Ensures IAM governance is enforced at the correct organizational boundary.

location.description: The location of the Policy Binding
location.rationale: Enforces centralized IAM policy binding control.

policy_binding_id.rationale: Ensures unique identification of IAM policy bindings.

display_name.description: Optional description of the policy binding.

annotations.rationale: Used for governance and tracking only.

policy_kind.description: Type of policy attached in this binding.
policy_kind.rationale: Restricts IAM binding to secure boundary enforcement policies.

condition.description: CEL condition for fine-grained policy enforcement.
condition.rationale: Allows conditional IAM enforcement based on attributes.

description.compliant: Restricts access based on time window
